text.ru: Один луч — и в нём уже все цвета.

art: Iris, a poised duelist-painter, raises a faceted glass prism; a beam of white light enters and arcs out of it as a rainbow fan sweeping across her, her brush trailing refracted color

text.ru: Я пишу не светом, а его отсутствием.

art: Erebus, half-swallowed in shadow, haloed by the bright corona of a total eclipse; darkness drips from his brush as he paints with the absence of light

text.ru: Смешай два света — и родится третий.

art: Tiziana, a painter holding up a large round glowing artist's palette laden with light-paints in one hand, sweeping a broad brush across it with the other as two colours stream together and bloom into a third where they meet

text.ru: Я бужу свет огранённым.

art: Gemma holds a many-faceted crystal up to the light and strikes a clean facet, splitting a thin beam into sharp geometric glints

text.ru: Летит на чужой огонь и приносит свой.

art: a small moth with smouldering cinder-dusted wings trailing sparks, darting low beneath raised shields straight at its mark

text.ru: Каждый камень в его праще ещё дышит жаром.

art: a lean crab-clawed creature whirling a sling of molten coals, one blazing coal arcing away as the brightest point

text.ru: Даже погаснув, успевает лизнуть напоследок.

art: a tiny wingless drake hatchling of cooling ash, jaws parting for one last scorching breath

text.ru: Тонок, да пробивает насквозь.

art: a large gnat with a long needle-lance for a proboscis, lowered like a couched spear to run its target clean through

text.ru: Чем больше пьёт, тем дольше тлеет.

art: a swollen tick latched onto its prey, its body glowing hotter and fuller the more it drinks

text.ru: Один укол — и щит уже ни при чём.

art: a hornet with an oversized barbed stinger, driving it clean through a shield-bearer into the space beyond

text.ru: Проносится сквозь строй, будто того и нет.

art: a galloping horse-shaped beast of drifting ash and embers streaking untouched past a wall of braced defenders

text.ru: Пляшет — и раны хозяина затягивает жаром.

art: a whirling serpentine ember-creature spinning in a fire-dance, threads of warm light spiralling back toward its master

text.ru: Рвёт — и чужой кровью гасит собственные раны.

art: a lean lynx mid-pounce with claws bared, its own gashes searing shut in the heat as it strikes

text.ru: Небо занялось — и каждый клинок стал злее.

art: a low blood-tinged sunrise cresting over a battlefield, its glow lending every silhouette a sharper burning edge

text.ru: Плюнуть жаром — недолго и недалеко, но метко.

art: a sudden gout of fire spat from off-frame, a compact bolt of flame streaking toward a single target

text.ru: Панцирь набит жаром, и он не любит терпеть.

art: a fat armored beetle with a cracked venting shell packed with heat, swelling an instant from bursting

text.ru: Заряжает кристаллом, стреляет углями.

art: a scorpion-like creature raising a tail fused into a glowing ember-cannon, a bright spark leaving the muzzle

text.ru: Что клинок отнимает, то жар возвращает хозяину.

art: a heavy branded ox-beast marked with searing glyphs, warm light streaming back to its master with every goring blow

text.ru: Пока горит — вокруг всё точит когти жарче.

art: a squat coral-like polyp rooted to the ground, radiating a shimmering heat-haze that sharpens everything near it

text.ru: Ритм гонит вперёд и не даёт остыть.

art: a pair of taut war-drums wreathed in fire, a shockwave of heat pulsing outward with every beat

text.ru: Он не целит в строй — он целит выше.

art: a towering column of fire plunging from a smoke-dark sky onto one distant point, everything between it left untouched

text.ru: Толстостенна и терпелива — бьёт весь бой.

art: a heavy siege-turtle with an ember-cannon fused to its thick shell, belching a bright spark downrange

text.ru: Летит долго, а падает точно в лоб.

art: a red-hot comet with a long ember tail plunging out of a dark sky toward one far target

text.ru: Идёт напрямик, и даже смерть его обжигает.

art: a towering colossus of molten stone striding straight through a wall of defenders, heat bleeding from its cracked hide

text.ru: Смотришь сквозь — и не понимаешь, где стена.

art: a broad manta-ray of shimmering heat-mirage gliding wide across the lane, spreading to take the first blow and wave it aside

text.ru: Успевает сверкнуть первым.

art: a tiny glass-winged sunbird flashing in on a needle of glare, stabbing first, its nicks sealing as it hovers

text.ru: Стоит на своём и не сходит.

art: a long-legged crane standing immovable as a roadside marker, refusing to yield the path, its wounds closing overnight

text.ru: Возьмёт чужую беду на себя.

art: a small ward-spirit shaped like a hanging sun-charm hovering before an ally, drinking a hostile spell and pulling blows to itself

text.ru: Кто идёт на него — тот падает первым.

art: a slender blade-armed mantis of dawn keeping guard, its edged forelimbs cutting down each attacker before it can land a hit

text.ru: На два удара света не станет.

art: a small dark disc sliding across the sun's face, dropping one distant figure into deep shadow

text.ru: Полдень замирает, и раны стихают.

art: a hushed noon meadow at the day's still point, wounds quietly closing over the calm grass

text.ru: Каждый глоток света возвращается врагу жаром.

art: a haloed serpent coiled into a burning sun-ring, a crown of rays at its brow, flinging a hot lance out whenever light gathers near

text.ru: Полыхнёт — и противник слепнет на подходе.

art: a crackling thunder-hawk of heat-lightning alighting in the path, its sudden flash searing a lone foe blind on approach

text.ru: Что о него разбивается, то лечит хозяина.

art: a towering pillar-trunked treant rooted to the field, each blow that breaks on its bark sending warmth back to its master

text.ru: Свет, процеженный сквозь цвет, чинит павших.

art: a great stained-glass rose window ablaze at midday, warm beams knitting the most broken defender whole

text.ru: В зените никто не смотрит вверх.

art: a blinding overhead noon sun flooding the field, every enemy flinching and shielding its eyes

text.ru: За ним и герой становится стеной.

art: a hulking dawn-shelled tortoise planting itself as a living rampart, its broad back hardening the hero behind into armor

text.ru: Гаснет — и напоследок слепит убийц.

art: a lantern-moth of guttering light, its halo swallowing a hostile spell, its dying flash searing nearby foes blind

text.ru: Изматывает жарой, а сам всё крепче.

art: a massive heat-shimmer aurochs standing its ground in the field, wearing attackers down, its bulk thickening as the day burns hotter

text.ru: Разит первым и раной кормит хозяина.

art: a scarab beetle sheathed in faceted heliodor-gem plates, its edged shell flashing to strike first, blows on it feeding warmth to its wielder

text.ru: В высшей точке бьёт дважды и не гаснет.

art: a blazing phoenix at the peak of its climb, lashing twice with wings of noon-fire and mending itself as it hangs aloft

text.ru: Всякий целебный луч он оборачивает клинком.

art: a great sun-dragon curled into a slow-turning wheel walling the field, hurling each gathered healing-ray back as a burning spoke

text.ru: Держит строй и добивает светом дважды.

art: a colossal radiant lion-titan maned in noon-fire holding the line, striking the far hero twice in one blazing charge

text.ru: Свет уходит весь — и возвращается только к тебе.

art: a total solar eclipse blacking out the sky over the enemy ranks, a thin corona bleeding back toward the caster

text.ru: Первый цветок дня — и первый лишний кристалл.

art: a small primrose bud unfurling at dawn, drawing a single crystal out of the first light

text.ru: Забьёт из земли — и щедро.

art: a spring welling up through cracked earth, two crystals rising and turning in the upflow

text.ru: Роет вглубь и выносит свет наружу.

art: a burrowing mole with broad crystal-tipped claws, surfacing from the soil clutching a freshly unearthed shard

text.ru: Горсть за горстью — и поле полно всходов.

art: a walking seed-pod creature scattering spores by the fistful, sprouts rising wherever each one lands

text.ru: Обовьёт и стравит — сам в стороне.

art: a mass of grasping vines lashing out to drag one creature hard against another in a strangling knot

text.ru: Дай ему волю — и он перерастёт всё.

art: a single sapling erupting in one surge into a towering crown of leaves

text.ru: Лопнет — и на его месте двое.

art: a bloated puffball fungus mid-burst, two small sprout-forms tumbling out of its spore-cloud

text.ru: С каждым днём гуще и злее.

art: a dense living hedge bristling with long thorns, thickening taller and meaner season by season

text.ru: Чем гуще подлесок, тем оно сильнее.

art: a seething swarm of small thorn-shelled crawlers knotting into one mass, growing fiercer the denser the thicket crowding around them

text.ru: Под его сенью раны заживают сами.

art: a broad ancient oak with a spreading crown, a soft steady fall of leaf-litter mending the wounded sheltering beneath it

text.ru: Что ни утро — то полная горсть.

art: a heavy fruit-laden tree, two ripe crystalline fruits dropping from its boughs at first light each dawn

text.ru: Растёт быстрее, чем его успевают срубить.

art: a towering treant warden of trunk and root, visibly swelling broader and taller with each passing turn

text.ru: Срежь его — и семя вернётся в ладонь.

art: a hardy perennial flower on a tall stem; cut down, it casts a single seed that drifts off to sprout anew

text.ru: Кормится всем, что умирает вокруг.

art: a heaving mound of loamy soil and tangled roots hunching upright, swelling bigger with every creature that dies nearby

text.ru: Лес встаёт весь и разом.

art: a whole grove of trees tearing their roots loose from the soil and heaving upright together

text.ru: Размером с всё, что ты успел скопить.

art: a vast slumbering forest-spirit grown from living heartwood, its pulsing core swelling larger the more crystals lie hoarded around it

text.ru: Целый подлесок, сросшийся в одно.

art: a lumbering colossus woven from a whole tangled undergrowth of vine and root, bulkier the fuller the field

text.ru: Столетия роста в одном шаге.

art: a colossal mammoth sculpted from ancient moss and knotted roots, growing more massive and towering with every ponderous step

text.ru: Корень, из которого поднялся весь лес.

art: a vast root-being heaving up out of the earth, its canopy still climbing toward the sky

text.ru: Черпай — не вычерпаешь.

art: a deep stone well brimming with liquid light, three crystals welling up and spilling over its rim

text.ru: Смотрит на шаг вперёд остальных.

art: a small crystalline drake peering through a clear lens of ice, a faint image of the next card surfacing in its eye

text.ru: Встал на пост — и всё вокруг застыло.

art: a horned ice-feathered owl perched watch on a frozen post, its unblinking stare sheathing a single foe in creeping rime

text.ru: Медленно, но не сдвинуть.

art: a massive ice-shelled tortoise squatting immovable, the deck's coming cards frozen dimly visible deep within its translucent glacial shell

text.ru: Придёт волна — и унесёт лишнее обратно.

art: a rolling spirit of tidewater sweeping across the field, its receding wave carrying one enemy shape back off the board

text.ru: Каждое заклинание точит его грани.

art: a faceted crystal dragonfly hovering in place, every wing-edge flaring keener each time a spell is cast nearby

text.ru: Один луч входит — два выходят.

art: a gliding crystalline manta ray, a single beam entering its clear body and leaving as two diverging rays

text.ru: Копит свет заклинаний и бьёт им.

art: a slowly drifting cut-glass jellyfish, its faceted bell hoarding each passing spell as an ever-brightening inner glare

text.ru: Дышит — и рядом всё покрывается инеем.

art: a towering colossus sheathed in thick hoarfrost, its frozen breath locking a nearby foe in a hard crust of rime

text.ru: Всплывёт из глубины — и море встанет льдом.

art: a vast deep-sea leviathan breaching the surface, the shock of cold flash-freezing the entire enemy line at once

text.ru: Схватит за горло холодом.

art: a clawed hand of jagged frost clamping shut around a single figure, ice climbing up its limbs to hold it fast

text.ru: Утянет чужого — или спасёт своего.

art: a fierce undertow curling back off a shore, dragging one lone figure out and under with it

text.ru: Видит дальше — берёт лучшее.

art: a still scrying-pool mirroring several distant cards, one of them rising up out of the water as light

text.ru: Луч, что не гасят ни щит, ни нимб.

art: a needle-thin lance of light punching clean through a shielded figure, the useless shield splintering apart around it

text.ru: Тянется медленно — а укроет всех.

art: a slow sheet of creeping frost spreading edge to edge across the whole enemy field, an instant from closing over it

text.ru: Разом и надолго.

art: the entire enemy line caught and sealed together inside one solid block of clear ice

text.ru: Течёт под льдом — и не иссякает.

art: a swift meltwater stream running beneath a lid of ice, a spreading fan of cards carried up in its current

text.ru: Ляжет весь строй — и надолго.

art: the whole enemy army sealed upright inside towering pillars of clear ice, entombed for a long winter

text.ru: Мороз кусает — и рука слабеет.

art: a sudden cold-front rolling low over the field, enemy silhouettes hunching and stiffening as the frost bites at them

text.ru: Сквозь дымку и заклинание идёт с трудом.

art: a hanging curtain of pale freezing mist drawn across the field, thickening the air until it muffles every spell

text.ru: Всё двоится — и удар тоже.

art: a shimmering doubled after-image lying over the whole field, every shape softly split into two overlapping copies

text.ru: Пока не вспыхнет — его не видно.

art: a tiny violet glow-beetle dimming its own light to a faint ember, unseen in the dark until it suddenly flares

text.ru: Явь ли, тень ли — поди разбери, которая.

art: a half-real violet jellyfish drifting through gloom, its body flickering apart into three faint overlapping copies

text.ru: Ты его заметишь, когда уже поздно.

art: a low-slung violet panther of shadow stalking forward, its outline dissolving into the surrounding dark until too late

text.ru: В его тени легко спрятать первый шаг.

art: a broad-winged violet moth at dusk, its wide shadow spilling across the ground to hide whatever slips beneath it

text.ru: Свет уходит — и с ним сила.

art: a creeping violet dusk sweeping over a lone enemy creature, draining its glow until it stands shrunken and faint

text.ru: Шагни в марево — и пропади для чужих глаз.

art: a rippling violet heat-mirage swallowing an allied creature whole, leaving only a wavering blur where it stood

text.ru: Их двое — а бьёт настоящий.

art: a sleek violet shadow-fox padding beside its own hollow twin, one of them solid, the other an empty copy

text.ru: Светит так, что вокруг только тени.

art: a deep violet anglerfish trailing a dim lure that casts more shadow than light, pooling darkness for allies to hide in

text.ru: Повтори слух — и вот их уже двое.

art: a violet whisper shattering in the air into a faint hollow duplicate of a nearby creature

text.ru: Спрятан в рукаве до самого удара.

art: a violet shadow-mantis holding its blade-arms folded and unseen, poised a single breath before the killing strike

text.ru: Убьёшь — а он приснится снова.

art: a great violet nightjar gliding silent through the dark, a fainter after-image trailing a wingbeat behind it

text.ru: Ложный свет — но бьёт по-настоящему.

art: a false violet dawn flaring over your ranks, every shadowy ally surging brighter for one fleeting moment

text.ru: Не рой, а морок роя — но с когтями.

art: a violet haze breaking apart into a swarm of three small flickering illusory clawed shapes

text.ru: Одного мало — их всегда чуть больше.

art: a violet spectral stag beside its own hollow double, a third faint outline of antlers already forming behind them

text.ru: Целься в него — попадёшь в другого.

art: a wavering violet shadow-serpent coiled in guard, an incoming beam bending off its scales toward another shape entirely

text.ru: Не убить — просто отменить.

art: a lone enemy creature unravelling into drifting violet threads and blowing apart into nothing

text.ru: Чем гуще мороки вокруг, тем он грознее.

art: a violet raven-shade growing fiercer as a flock of faint illusory ravens wheels ever thicker around it

text.ru: Правит войском, которого нет.

art: a vast crowned violet shadow-cuttlefish throned above a host of hollow phantom copies, hostile light sliding off its mantle

text.ru: Дремлет среди кристаллов — пока не проснётся.

art: a huge slumbering violet shadow-toad squatting disguised among banked crystals, one heavy eye just cracking open

text.ru: Схорони его загодя — вернётся в свой час.

art: a towering violet shadow-cicada clawing up from a cache of buried crystals, hostile light sliding off its carapace

text.ru: Лопнет искрой — и достанет до лица.

art: a tiny flea swollen with sparks, leaping high and bursting into a hot flash as it lands

text.ru: Сгниёт — и на его месте новый.

art: a small rotting mushroom sagging on its stalk, one swollen spore-pod bulging to burst

text.ru: Летит в лицо и там сгорает.

art: a small soot-trailing fly of guttering ember, flaring white-hot as it is snuffed against its target

text.ru: Кормит собой два новых ростка.

art: a fat carrion scarab feasting on rot, its cracked shell splitting to spill two spores that sprout where they land

text.ru: Тянет из света лишний кристалл.

art: a resinous sapling shoot unfurling toward the light, a crystal beading like sap at its tip

text.ru: Из-под савана уже пробилась зелень.

art: a moss-wrapped corpse-husk with a green sprout forcing up between its ribs

text.ru: Сноп под серп — а взамен полные руки.

art: a bound sheaf of grain-stalks cut through by a curved sickle, two cards lifting free from the falling straw

text.ru: Каждая ваша рана — чужая беда.

art: a squat blood-drinking pitcher-plant creature veined red and green, spitting a searing thorn at the enemy whenever a nearby ally is healed

text.ru: Пьёт кровь и жиреет на падали.

art: a tangled thorn-bramble beast lapping blood with red barbed thorns while its green creepers fatten on the corpses rotting around it

text.ru: Рвёт — и жаром латает хозяина.

art: a lean wolf with coal-glowing eyes mid-lunge, warm light flowing back to seal its master's wounds

text.ru: Пасёт грибное стадо.

art: a fungus-antlered stag guiding a drifting flock of tiny spore-sprites along

text.ru: Раздулся падалью — лопнет тремя.

art: a huge bloated puffball mushroom straining at its skin, three fat spore-sacs bulging and about to burst free

text.ru: Что скосит своё — тем и растёт.

art: a towering scythe-limbed mantis of red blades and green stalk-armor, cutting down a small friendly sprout-wisp and swelling as it harvests it

text.ru: Прилив крови бьёт в чужой берег.

art: a breaking tide of crimson blood and green sap surging across the field, hurling a searing lance at the enemy each time a wound is healed

text.ru: Жрёт мертвечину и пухнет.

art: a fat glistening slug gorging on carrion, its bloated body visibly swelling larger as it feeds on the fallen

text.ru: Каждой смерти — плата кровью.

art: a gaunt elk-spirit with green moss-antlers and red weeping flanks looming over grave-mounds, flinging a burning blood-mote at the enemy whenever an ally falls

text.ru: Всех на костёр — и пусть враг горит.

art: a funeral pyre of red flame and green kindling-boughs consuming a row of small friendly wisps, a wave of scorching heat rolling toward the enemy

text.ru: Ест прах и сеет прах.

art: a hulking tusked boar-scavenger of red embers and green fungal crust, rooting through ash and swelling on the dead, bursting a spore when slain

text.ru: Каждое заклинание — новая искра в брюшке.

art: a firefly whose ember-abdomen flares brighter each time a spell crackles past

text.ru: Ловит разряды и точит клешни.

art: a mantis with raised blade-arms, arcs of sparking current leaping between its scythes as magic passes

text.ru: Молнией мимо строя — прямо в лицо.

art: a darting swift crackling with lightning, one wing shedding embers and the other trailing frost, slipping low past a line of defenders

text.ru: Бьёт током всё сильнее с каждым словом.

art: an electric eel coiled to strike, sparks and creeping frost chasing along its body as its charge builds ever brighter

text.ru: Один укус — а жал будто два.

art: a hornet driving its barbed stinger clean through a shield, the strike splitting into twin after-images, one ember-hot, one frost-cold

text.ru: Смотрит в угли и видит ход вперёд.

art: a keen-eyed salamander crouched over live coals, frost misting off its spines, gazing into the embers to read the coming turn

text.ru: Гроза слушается каждого его слова.

art: a towering storm-drake, embers in its throat and frost on its wings, lightning gathering along its horns as spells are spoken

text.ru: Вьётся в тумане, что глушит чужие чары.

art: a long serpent winding through a muffling storm-fog, sparks flickering along its coils and hoarfrost trailing from its tail

text.ru: Короткая вспышка — прямо в лицо.

art: a quick lick of fire flaring off-frame toward a single distant point

text.ru: Разряд под дых.

art: a sharp colourless spark snapping into a single figure, a quick jolt driven straight into its gut

text.ru: Тонкий разряд — сквозь щит и нимб.

art: a needle-thin bolt, half searing fire and half biting frost, punching clean through a shield and a halo into its mark

text.ru: По морозу — и трещина до дна.

art: a fracture line of frost racing across an already-frozen figure until it splinters apart into shards

text.ru: Свои — ярче, чужие — тусклее.

art: a battlefield split in two, one half flaring with ember-heat and the other locked in frost, allies blazing while foes hunch dimming

text.ru: Чем больше искр за ход, тем громче удар.

art: a roiling thundercloud crackling between ember-heat and frost, hurling a single enormous bolt down at a distant target, louder with every spark

text.ru: Разлом жара под ногами врага.

art: a searing molten rift tearing open in the ground beneath a single enemy shape

text.ru: Тянет свет из-под мха.

art: a moss-backed toad basking with its face to the light, drawing a single crystal down out of the light

text.ru: Сеет пушечное мясо по требованию.

art: a squat bristly boar, seeds shaking loose from its hide to sprout around its hooves

text.ru: Жиреет на всём, что гниёт рядом.

art: a fat lumbering beetle burrowing through humus, its thick shell swelling heavier as fodder rots and decays around it

text.ru: Убьёшь — вернётся тенью.

art: a dim violet phantom-wisp half-dissolved into shadow, a fainter echo of itself drifting a step behind

text.ru: Их сразу трое — поди пойми, который.

art: a violet shadow-heron splitting into three faint overlapping duplicates that mirror its every motion

text.ru: С каждого утра — двойная жатва света.

art: a hulking mud-caked fen-newt churning the marsh, two bright crystals welling up from the turned muck each dawn

text.ru: Оплетает могилы и тянет мёртвых назад.

art: a serpentine ivy-creature of green leaves and violet grave-shade coiling over a burial mound, dragging up a pale phantom as a bright seed drifts back to hand

text.ru: Одна лань — а следов вдвое.

art: a slender fawn crowned with moss-and-fern antlers casting a hollow violet double of itself, both standing bolder amid a crowding thicket

text.ru: Размером со всё, что ты скопил.

art: a lumbering colossus grown from green crystal-vines with a violet phantom twin looming behind it, its bulk swelling to match the mana hoarded near

text.ru: Один морок сеет целый рой.

art: a wisp-spirit of tangled green vines and violet haze budding a faint hollow copy of itself, both sprawling denser as the undergrowth crowds in around them

text.ru: Что скошено — вновь в ладонь.

art: two seeds flung up out of a turned furrow, arcing back toward a waiting open hand

text.ru: Дремлет в кристаллах — и растёт во сне.

art: a hulking tortoise-beast with a mossy green rampart-shell, sleeping disguised among banked crystals beneath a violet cloak of shadow, thickening as it grows

text.ru: В россыпи бликов легко спрятать первый шаг.

art: a hanging violet veil of scattered glints, pooling deep shadow for allies to slip unseen into

text.ru: Гряда чинит всё, что ещё дышит.

art: a steaming bed of rich mulch and rotting leaves, gently mending the wounded creatures rooted down into it

text.ru: Растёт и вширь, и ввысь.

art: a shaggy plodding ox woven from living thorn-brambles, its bristling coat thickening taller and broader with every turn

text.ru: Крадётся в сумерках мимо любых стен.

art: a lithe violet shadow-marten slinking unseen through the dusk, slipping past a standing wall into the gloom

text.ru: Целься в него — попадёшь в эхо.

art: a violet shadow-bat wheeling through the dark, an incoming beam bending off it toward a fainter echo of itself

text.ru: Прикрутит фитиль — и враг слепнет.

art: a dusky glowfly pinching its own lamp down to a smoulder, snuffing a single foe's sight as the flame gutters

text.ru: Затаится в кристаллах, встанет незримой.

art: a slender violet stick-insect of shadow lurking motionless among banked crystals, its edges dissolving into the dark

text.ru: Свет манит удары на себя.

art: a beacon-crab hoisting a lantern-claw aloft, its light pulling blows onto its armored shell, the first one turned aside

text.ru: Двое дразнят, бьют по обоим.

art: a violet shadow-peacock fanning its tail beside a hollow mirror-copy, both taunting and drawing the enemy's eye

text.ru: Заслонка держит и чинит сама себя.

art: an armored armadillo curling into a living shutter across the lane, its cracked plates knitting shut again each turn

text.ru: Входит — и гасит первого попавшегося.

art: a broad watch-mastiff barring the gate, its first hard glare dousing a random foe's sight as it takes its post

text.ru: Молча глотает первое проклятье за союзника.

art: a squat sentinel-toad planted before its ally, silently gulping the first hostile spell down its throat and drawing blows to itself

text.ru: Высветит всё, что враг прячет в запасе.

art: a great watch-owl perched high, its searchlight gaze throwing open the enemy's hidden reserves while it dares blows onto itself

text.ru: Спит в кристаллах, встанет незримым.

art: a violet shadow-scorpion buried among banked crystals, blade-tail raised to strike the instant it wakes unseen

text.ru: Разобьётся — и полыхнёт по глазам.

art: a crystal-winged dragonfly striking first, and when it shatters its splintering flash sears nearby foes blind

text.ru: Каждый ход гасит по одному.

art: a slow-pacing gaol-keeper basilisk, each turn fixing one foe with its stare and snuffing that creature's sight

text.ru: Держит фронт и чинится к утру.

art: a great antlered stag of dawn braced across the pass at first light, its wounds closing again by morning

text.ru: Ослеп — значит приговорён.

art: a violet unmaking-ray erasing a dazzled, blinded enemy figure into drifting motes

text.ru: Бей его — попадёшь в соседа; убей — ослепнешь.

art: a broad violet shadow-crab planting itself as a living cage, attacks bending off its shell, bursting blinding-bright when it breaks

text.ru: Проснётся — и весь строй ослепнет.

art: a vast stone-shelled colossus buried in violet dusk among banked crystals, heaving awake and loosing a blinding golden flash across the whole enemy line

text.ru: Незрима — и бьёт дважды.

art: a scythe-limbed mantis dissolving into violet shadow, its twin sickle-blades flashing with yellow glare as they cut a target down twice, unseen

text.ru: Незримая — и гасит по одному каждый ход.

art: a huge matriarch spider crouched in violet dusk-webs, her many eyes and silk glinting gold, dimming one foe's glow each turn while hidden

text.ru: Река наносит — и щедро, и с толком.

art: a spread of river-silt fanning across a floodplain, a single crystal surfacing as the current sorts and reveals the path ahead

text.ru: Плавает и тянет свет со дна.

art: a broad lily pad afloat on still water, drawing a crystal up from the depths beneath it

text.ru: Скачет по илу, роняет ростки.

art: a mudskipper fish hopping across glistening silt, a young sprout springing up in its wake

text.ru: Плодородная пойма — полные руки.

art: a rich fertile floodplain suddenly bursting into lush growth, two broad leaves unfurling and lifting free like drawn cards

text.ru: Плотину прорвало — и всё пошло в рост.

art: a bursting levee loosing a muddy flood, three small sprouts riding the surge as the whole field lurches into growth

text.ru: Отлив уносит лишнее прочь.

art: a receding ebb-tide sliding back from the shore, sweeping one figure off the field as the water withdraws

text.ru: Мелок, а холодом кусает.

art: a tiny minnow flicking past a much larger foe, leaving it rimed stiff and motionless in its wake

text.ru: Затор льда — надолго встанет.

art: a grinding jam of river ice-floes crushing together around a single figure, pinning it locked in place

text.ru: Ряска ширится, а лишнее сплавляет.

art: a living raft of matted green duckweed grown over drifting ice, thickening as the field crowds, a cold swell heaving one foe off its edge

text.ru: Растёт с запасом — и студит на входе.

art: a newt with moss-green flanks and a spine of quartz ice, swelling with every crystal you hoard, breathing a rime of frost across a foe

text.ru: Несёт ростки и студит берега.

art: a lithe river-otter woven from rushing green-and-blue whitewater, scattering sprouting seeds from its wake, hoarfrost trailing off its whiskers to chill a foe

text.ru: Тонкий лёд чинит своих и студит чужих.

art: a broad flat lichen-backed ray gliding low over the field, mending allies in its green shadow, its frost-rimed wings numbing every foe it passes

text.ru: Нырнёт — и унесёт добычу с собой.

art: a kingfisher with moss-green plumage and frost-rimed wings diving to snatch a foe off the field, dawn light beading into a crystal on its back

text.ru: Разливается ростками и смывает чужое.

art: a huge brooding river-toad swollen with meltwater, spilling sprouting green seedlings from her mottled back while a cold surge sweeps one foe away

text.ru: Растёт с рекой и студит на подходе.

art: a colossal reed-maned river-behemoth of surging floodwater, swelling with every crystal you hoard, its frozen breath locking a foe stiff as it wades ashore

text.ru: Разольётся — и весь берег во льду.

art: a vast river-leviathan surging up from the green-and-blue flood, sprouting reeds streaming from its hide, a sheet of frost flash-freezing the whole enemy shore

text.ru: Тихо оплетает и дорастает до стены.

art: a coil of living ivy creeping upward, its vines thickening broader and stronger turn by turn into a strangling curtain

text.ru: Держит фронт и куёт герою броню.

art: a heavy-horned rhinoceros planted as a living gatehouse, its braced stance layering fresh armor over the hero behind it

text.ru: Стена, что сама дорастает до угрозы.

art: a dense living hedge bristling with branches barring the way, growing taller and thornier each turn to block attackers

text.ru: Накинь покров — и удар, и проклятье мимо.

art: a mantle of light settling over an ally, a shield-halo and a ward-halo kindling around it together

text.ru: Ясный день — броня герою и покой раненым.

art: a bright golden noon over a green meadow, sunlight settling as plate-armor on the hero while drifting leaves close the wounded's cuts

text.ru: Растёт в титана и топит клок агро.

art: a young oak broadening its trunk each turn, warm light streaming back from its boughs to its keeper

text.ru: Сад роняет по два кристалла в утро.

art: a tended garden plot where crystals bloom on stalks like flowers, two fresh shards ripening and hardening each dawn

text.ru: Стягивает удары и глотает первое проклятье.

art: a broad pangolin braced at a hard angle, its overlapping scales pulling blows onto it while a halo swallows the first hostile spell

text.ru: И в смерти вспыхнет врагу в глаза.

art: a bristle-backed boar plated in flaking mica-scales holding the lane, its plates flaring blinding as it finally breaks

text.ru: Растёт в неубиваемое тело.

art: a broad hawthorn shrub bristling with long thorns, swelling denser and larger every turn into an unkillable thicket

text.ru: Растущий бастион под бронёй.

art: a vast world-tortoise, its domed mossy shell arching like the firmament and plating thicker with golden light as it swells into a wall

text.ru: Раздувается от целого строя стен.

art: a towering elk whose antlers branch into a whole golden-leafed oak grove, spreading broader and barring the road as more woodland crowds in behind it

text.ru: Чинится и растёт быстрее, чем его бьют.

art: a gnarled old elm-treant rooted across the road, its split bark knitting shut under a sheath of golden light while fresh green shoots bud faster than axes can bite

text.ru: Растёт и бьёт дважды под бронёй.

art: a colossal oak-titan straining to hold up the sky on its golden boughs, its green-barked trunk swelling as two massive limb-arms hammer down twice

text.ru: Башня, что бьёт дважды телом от всего строя.

art: a towering keep-shaped guardian of interlaced golden roots and green bramble rising from a dense thicket, barring the way and slamming down twice with root-fists
